$comment: Configurations compared. kind: none (agent's own tools only) | gearmod (this project's index, bench/servers) | mcp (external MCP server) | map (text map added to the prompt).
Placeholders in commands: {root} = folder the agent works in, {work} = bench-data/work, {repo} = repository id.
copy: true = the tool writes into the project folder (e.g. .codegraph/), so it gets its own copy made by prepare.mjs.
setup: command run once per repository copy before the runs, with the project as working folder (indexing time is recorded apart, not in the agent's time).
hint: adds the sentence from config/prompts.json telling the agent the code tools exist (the same sentence for every tool).
Versions are pinned (npx/uvx download them on first use). Commands from each project's README on 2026-11-03; run `node bench/run.mjs experiments/smoke.json --check` before a real run.

codebase-memory.$install: PowerShell: irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/DeusData/codebase-memory-mcp/main/install.ps1 | iex  (or the release binary on PATH). The README says the agent indexes with its index_repository tool; the hint stays the same as for the other tools.
codebase-memory.$status: 2026-11-04: not usable on this machine, so it is left out of every experiment. The release binary (v0.12.1, SHA-256 checked against checksums.txt) runs --version, but refuses to install or to run any tool: 'activation could not reserve exclusive access ... C:\Users\<user>: DACL entry 3 grants mutation rights 0x000d0152 to untrusted identity (other S-1-5-21-...-1004)', then 'could not load saved runtime settings'. The SID is a second local account of the same owner with Full Control on the profile folder, a legitimate setup that must stay. The tool finds the profile through the Windows API, so overriding HOME, USERPROFILE, APPDATA, LOCALAPPDATA or CBM_CACHE_DIR does not help, and an owner-only folder elsewhere does not help either. Ways to include it later: another machine or Windows user whose profile grants no other account write access, or the Linux build under WSL.

aider-map.$comment: Prints Aider's repository map without calling any model (the model name only satisfies the CLI). 1024 tokens, close to GearMod's own map.
